title: Backspin Basketball Flies Off Dam
summary: A short Veritasium video showing how far a backspinning basketball would travel dropped off a dam. It demonstrates the Magnus effect and links to Flettner rotor ships and aircraft.
why: HN uses it as a quick, clear demonstration of the Magnus effect behind spinning-cylinder ships and planes.
